meta.name: Washington Legacy Tour
meta.title: Washington, D.C.
meta.subtitle: November 9–12, 2026
meta.welcome: Four days of history, fellowship, and unforgettable places. Keep the schedule, locations, and helpful details close at hand.
meta.status: Schedule subject to changes. Check with Ashlee or Pastor Rob for the latest bus meeting instructions.

announcements.title: Please read before departure
announcements.message: Monday bus departure: 10:00 a.m. from Emmanuel Baptist Church; park in the rear lot. Dress in layers and carry a photo ID. Tuesday evening's monument tour may be chilly.

announcements.title: Wednesday pickup location not yet final
announcements.message: The 300 block of L’Enfant Plaza SW has been identified as a possible pickup location. It is NOT confirmed. Follow Ashlee and Pastor Rob's day-of instructions.

items.title: Depart Emmanuel Baptist Church
items.description: Meet for charter-bus departure. Travelers may leave cars in the rear parking lot.

items.title: Travel and comfort stops
items.description: Two rest stops are planned. A restroom is available on the charter bus. Dinner arrangements are to be determined.

items.title: National Harbor area arrival
items.description: Estimated arrival only; traffic may affect timing.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check in at your assigned hotel: AC Hotel National Harbor or Residence Inn National Harbor. Dinner on your own or en route.

items.title: Explore Mount Vernon
items.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Hwy, Mount Vernon, VA 22121
items.description: Visit the estate and historic grounds. Lunch on site at a restaurant or quick-service location. Allow time for restrooms at the orientation and museum facilities.

items.title: Reserved mansion tour groups
items.description: Reserved tours are divided into groups of 20, 20, and 15 at 12:10, 12:15, and 12:20 p.m. Follow your leader's group assignment.

items.title: Return to hotels
items.description: Depart Mount Vernon for National Harbor. Dinner on your own near the hotels.

items.title: Depart for evening monument tour
items.description: Scheduled sights: Washington Monument, World War II Memorial, Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam Veterans Memorial, Korean War Veterans Memorial, Jefferson Memorial, and Reflecting Pool. Specific stop order and time at each site are not given.

items.title: Return to hotels
items.description: Scheduled return from the evening monument tour.

itinerary.label: Wed · Nov 11
itinerary.heading: Museum of the Bible & Capitol Hill

items.title: Depart for Museum of the Bible
Museum of the Bible
items.description: Explore the museum. Lunch on your own. Toilets are located on visitor floors; family restrooms are on B1 and floors 2–6.

items.title: Self-guided National Mall & Capitol time
items.description: Independent exploration. Use the official map and plan ahead for walking, restrooms, and the group's next bus meeting instructions.

items.title: Depart for hotel break
items.description: Return to National Harbor for rest and dinner on your own.

items.title: Capitol security screening
items.description: Allow additional time for security. Follow the group leader's instructions.

items.title: Capitol Hill Worship Service
items.description: Group worship service as listed in the schedule.

items.title: Hotel checkout & depart for Arlington
items.description: Be packed and ready for hotel checkout and bus departure.

items.title: Arlington National Cemetery
items.description: Explore on foot or consider the narrated tram tour. The schedule estimates tram tickets at approximately $22; availability, group arrangements, and exact pricing remain unconfirmed. Restrooms and tram tickets are at the Welcome Center.

items.title: Depart for Connecticut
items.description: Return trip with two planned rest stops. Lunch and dinner stops are to be determined; evening arrival is expected.

places.name: National Harbor
places.summary: Our home base across the Potomac, with walkable dining and waterfront attractions.
places.detail: Both hotels are on Waterfront Street. Use the official waterfront directory to find restaurants, public restrooms, and walking routes.
places.dining: Options in the supplied companion include Silver Diner, Succotash, McCormick & Schmick's, and Grace's Mandarin. Check each restaurant's hours before visiting.
places.restrooms: Hotel guest facilities and public restrooms around the waterfront (verify access).

places.name: George Washington's Mount Vernon
places.summary: Explore George Washington's estate, its mansion, gardens, and the lives of people who worked there.
places.detail: Reserved mansion tours begin at 12:10, 12:15, and 12:20 p.m. with assigned groups. The estate includes exhibits about enslaved people and its working farms.
places.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Hwy, Mount Vernon, VA 22121
places.dining: Mount Vernon Inn Restaurant and The General's Canteen. Confirm opening hours.
places.restrooms: Ford Orientation Center, museum/education center, historic area, Mount Vernon Inn Restaurant.
places.accessibility: The grounds include varied terrain; contact the trip leader about mobility assistance.

audio.title: Official Mount Vernon Audio Tour
audio.description: Official 29-stop narrated tour through the Mount Vernon estate, with a take-home recap option. Pick up an audio device at the estate.

places.name: Washington Monument
places.summary: A marble obelisk honoring George Washington, completed in 1884.
places.detail: The monument's stone changes color partway up because construction resumed years later with marble from other quarries.
places.restrooms: Washington Monument Lodge / Sylvan Theater area; hours may vary.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: World War II Memorial
places.summary: A memorial honoring more than 16 million Americans who served during World War II.
places.detail: The Freedom Wall contains 4,048 gold stars, each representing approximately 100 Americans who died in military service.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Lincoln Memorial
places.summary: A solemn memorial to Abraham Lincoln, with grand columns and engraved speeches.
places.detail: Its 36 exterior columns represent the states at the time of Lincoln's death. The steps were the setting of historic civil-rights events.
places.address: 2 Lincoln Memorial Cir NW, Washington, DC 20002
places.restrooms: Use the public facilities near the memorial when open; evening access may be limited.

audio.title: Official Lincoln Memorial Audio-Described Guide
audio.description: National Park Service audio guide to the memorial and its history, divided into sections.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial
places.summary: A black granite wall inscribed with the names of Americans who died or remain missing.
places.detail: Names are arranged in the order of casualties, with the chronology beginning and ending near the middle of the memorial.
places.address: 5 Henry Bacon Dr NW, Washington, DC 20002

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Korean War Veterans Memorial
places.summary: Nineteen figures of soldiers on patrol honor those who served in the Korean War.
places.detail: Their reflection in the polished wall creates the visual effect of 38 figures, a reference to the 38th parallel.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Thomas Jefferson Memorial
places.summary: A domed memorial overlooking the Tidal Basin, honoring the third president.
places.detail: The original statue was plaster; the present bronze statue replaced it in 1947.
places.address: 16 E Basin Dr SW, Washington, DC 20242
places.restrooms: Public facilities at the memorial may have limited hours.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool
places.summary: The long reflecting pool provides an iconic view toward the Washington Monument.
places.detail: Construction of the pool was not complete when the Lincoln Memorial was dedicated in 1922.
places.address: Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, Washington, DC

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

places.name: Museum of the Bible
places.summary: An immersive museum examining the Bible's history, stories, and cultural influence.
places.detail: The museum is at 400 4th Street SW. The current general-admission offering includes regular galleries and selected experiences; group arrangements may differ.
places.dining: The museum's Manna restaurant and Milk + Honey café are options listed in the supplied companion; also see L’Enfant Plaza.
places.restrooms: Restrooms on all visitor floors; family restrooms on B1 and floors 2–6.
places.accessibility: Wheelchairs may be available at Coat Check on a first-come, first-served basis.

audio.title: Museum of the Bible — Official Mobile App
audio.description: Official self-guided and Top 10 tours with in-museum information. Bring your own headphones. The iOS app is rated 4.9/5 from 857 App Store ratings; Android rating 4.7/5 from 108 reviews (checked November 2026).

audio.title: Free Guided Museum Tours
audio.cost: Free with museum admission · on-site reservation
audio.description: Live guides, not recordings. Includes Highlights (60 minutes), Christian Faith (75 minutes), and World of Jesus of Nazareth (45 minutes). Availability changes; tickets first come, first served.

places.name: National Mall & Memorial Parks
places.summary: The city's monumental landscape, from Lincoln Memorial to Capitol Hill.
places.detail: Distances between major sites are significant; plan restrooms and short breaks. For navigation use the official National Park Service map.
places.restrooms: Smithsonian museums during their operating hours and designated public comfort stations.

audio.title: NPS App · Interpretive Audio & Accessibility
audio.description: Official National Park Service app with park details, offline content, and some audio descriptions. Not a single continuous narrated tour.

audio.title: Washington DC Monuments Tour — GPS Audio
audio.cost: iOS · Free download; full walking tour $16.99
audio.description: App Store 4.6/5 from 75 ratings (checked November 2026). GPS narration and offline listening after downloading the tour. Bring headphones and a power bank.

audio.title: Action Tour Guide — Monument Audio Walk
audio.description: GPS-triggered walking-tour narration from Action Tour Guide. Requires a purchase and app download. Exact star rating not independently established.

places.name: United States Capitol
places.summary: The meeting place of Congress, crowned by its cast-iron dome and Statue of Freedom.
places.detail: The dome was completed in January 1866. The bronze Statue of Freedom on top is 19 feet, 6 inches tall.
places.accessibility: Security screening is scheduled for 6:00 p.m. Wednesday; specific entrance instructions must come from trip leaders.

audio.title: Official Capitol Exhibition Hall Audio Tour
audio.description: A 95-minute narrated guide, or choose individual exhibit sections. This relates to the Visitor Center Exhibition Hall, not the Wednesday evening worship service.

places.name: Arlington National Cemetery
places.summary: A place of remembrance and military honors overlooking Washington.
places.detail: The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier has been guarded continuously since 1937. The cemetery is hilly and expansive; the authorized, live-narrated tram is an alternative to longer walks.
places.restrooms: Welcome Center and near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier; use facilities before a tram tour.
places.dining: Food is not permitted in the cemetery or Welcome Center. Plan meals afterward.
places.accessibility: The cemetery covers extensive terrain with hills. Ask about the authorized interpretive tram.

audio.title: Arlington Interpretive Tram (live narration)
audio.cost: Paid, live narration · Approx. $22 per trip schedule
audio.description: Arlington's only authorized interpretive tour bus offers a live-narrated hop-on/hop-off route with stops including the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. This is not a prerecorded audio tour; confirm ticket cost and schedule.

tips.title: Comfortable footwear
tips.description: Expect walking and standing on varied surfaces. Break in shoes before departure.

tips.title: November layers
tips.description: Evenings near the monuments can be cold and windy. Bring warm layers and a rain option.

tips.title: Photo identification
tips.description: Carry photo ID for security screenings. Arlington may require REAL ID-compliant identification for adults.

tips.title: Travel light
tips.description: Bag restrictions apply at some venues. Mount Vernon lists a 16 × 16 × 8-inch bag limit in the supplied FAQ.

tips.title: Emergencies
tips.description: For an immediate emergency, call 911. For group logistics, contact Ashlee or Pastor Rob.

items.a: Comfortable broken-in walking shoes, layers and a jacket, a compact umbrella or poncho, day bag, phone and power bank, photo ID, medications, water bottle, and payment for meals.
November historical averages are around 58°F by day and 41°F overnight. These are not the actual forecast. Expect chilly, breezy evenings near monuments; check current weather before departure.
Walking and standing are expected at Mount Vernon, monuments, Museum of the Bible, National Mall, and Arlington. Some routes are hilly or uneven. Discuss mobility concerns with Ashlee.

items.q: When and where does the bus depart?
items.a: 10:00 a.m. Monday, November 9, from Emmanuel Baptist Church. Travelers may leave cars in the rear parking lot. Two rest stops are planned.

AC Hotel National Harbor is listed for travelers requiring double beds; Residence Inn National Harbor is listed for travelers requiring a king bed. Confirm your individual assignment with the leaders.

items.q: Where is the Wednesday bus pickup?
items.a: The 300 block of L’Enfant Plaza SW is a likely location, south of Independence Avenue SW and north of Frontage Road SW, but it is NOT confirmed. Follow the leader's day-of instructions.
The schedule lists most meals on your own. Several travel-day meal stops remain to be determined.

Charter bus and planned rest stops en route. At Mount Vernon: Ford Orientation Center, museum and visitor facilities. Museum of the Bible: restrooms on visitor floors. At the Mall, use open museums and designated facilities. Arlington: Welcome Center and near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
Yes, at several sites. Travel light, allow extra time, and follow each venue's current bag and ID rules. Mount Vernon limits larger bags; Arlington prohibits food, with bottled water permitted.

items.q: What if I get separated from the group?
items.a: Call Ashlee or Pastor Rob, follow the announced bus meeting place and time, and stay with your assigned smaller group when applicable. Do not assume a possible pickup location is confirmed.
